name: Ura Bangumi ~Shinjin Joshi Ana Yokujou Namachuukei~
original_name: 裏番組～新人女子アナ欲情生中継～
source:
Enjoy hidden desires and complicating human relations in a confined TV station from a woman's point of view.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305064738/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1002996]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
從女性視角體驗與外界隔絕的電視臺中隱秘的慾望與錯綜複雜的人際關係。
